rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Steep through road lined with houses 9-10 m from the kerb.
reasons: Dwellings 9-10 m away on this side

drivers.seclusion: Townhouses and houses sit 9-13 m from the kerb; apartments and a pool house beyond.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb beside a sealed through road with narrow verge; a couple of cars stand near the top only.
drivers.traffic: Through route to the junction at the top; steady passing traffic.
drivers.convention: Little kerbside parking on this side; one or two cars at the far end.

sun_shade: Open road with scattered tree shade from the east side.

best_section.where: Bellevue Parade west kerb, midway up the hill past the driveways
